column2: LASER medium string -> a defined exchange set. `base` is derived from the model
itself, not guessed: both GEMs ship a default medium that IS M9 salts + aerobic
+ glucose at -10, so M9 is exactly those exchanges minus the carbon one. LB adds
every amino-acid exchange the model has plus its nucleoside/base exchanges
(riboflavin, PABA and folate exchanges do not exist in iML1515 and are recorded
as absent rather than silently skipped).
status=exact    the string names one of the two defined sets
status=aliased  a named medium not separately defined; the note says why the
status=fallback unresolved; solves under M9 but is stratified OUT of the
primary metric rather than silently defaulted
